completion:
Identify the building/floor/unit under inspection at the time of the occurrence event.
3. Note the beginning of the hour of the inspection and add four hours to determine the end of the inspection time window.
4. Record the units completed INSIDE the 4-hour window.
5. Record the units completed OUTSIDE of the 4-hour window.

Administration and Risk Services January 2022This guide is intended to assist all authorized personnel with access to the Rental Housing Regulatory Services (RHRs) system when documenting reports from inspection activities. Explanations and examples are provided by way of overall instructions and how to gather, document, and report Impoundment of Premises (Block 36) with regard to critical fire-safety deficiencies.
